article.story: WEST POINT, N.Y. -- — Rafael Castro's 16 points helped George Washington defeat Army 84-70 on Tuesday. Castro also contributed seven rebounds for the Revolutionaries (7-2). Garrett Johnson added 14 points and nine rebounds. Christian Jones also finished with 14 points. Jaxson Bell finished with 15 points for the Black Knights (3-7). Ryan Curry added 14 points and seven assists for Army. Jackson Furman had 11 points. George Washington took the lead for good with 7:04 left in the first half. The score was 45-37 at halftime, with Johnson racking up nine points. Castro led the way with a team-high 10 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
